prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1377; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm has been retained to represent our client in connection with a collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection and was struck by your insured's vehicle. Our client has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is pursuing a claim for compensation.

Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office, and do not contact our client directly. Kindly provide, within the time permitted by applicable law, a written disclosure of the bodily injury liability limits under the policy issued to your insured, including any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes, without limitation, the claim file, photographs, vehicle data and telematics records, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, recorded calls, adjuster notes, and any repair or total-loss appraisal records. Destruction or alteration of such materials may result in sanctions. We look forward to your prompt response.
